name: Project Progress Report
one_liner: The fuller, periodic report on how the project is doing against its baselines and Charter.
purpose: Gives a high-level overview of the project and its status. It includes a project overview — project stakeholders, milestones and deliverables, project plan, budget and costs — plus additional project details: scope changes, major risks and issues with actions taken, and achievements. For a multi-annual project whose overall vision and scope have not changed, it can be used to secure project approval for the following year; if the vision or scope has changed, an updated Project Charter should be submitted instead.
created_in: Executing Phase (Project Reporting, §7.4) — periodic, typically yearly
approved_by: Project Owner (PO) is Accountable; presented to the PSC and, for next-year approval, to the Appropriate Governance Body (AGB)
inputs: Project Status Reports from the period
feeds: AGB approval for the following year

lifecycle.what: Report listed in the Communications Management Plan
Compiled per reporting period, usually per year
Vehicle for escalating changes, risks, issues, re-baselining
Archived; feeds the Project-End Report evaluation

traps: Progress Report ≠ Status Report: Status is one page every 1–2 months; Progress is the fuller periodic report.
Several sections are marked yearly reporting only: 1.1 Executive Summary, 1.5 Budget and Costs, 2.1 Scope Changes.
It can secure next-year approval — but only if vision/scope is unchanged; otherwise submit an updated Project Charter.
Same RASCI row as the Project Status Report: both are outputs of Project Reporting (p.59), PO=A, PM=R.
The Quality Review Report is a separate PM² report, produced by the PM from the Quality Review Checklist.

castor_excerpt.title: Extract — Project Progress Report, Project CASTOR, reporting year 01 Jan – 31 Dec 2027, issued 26 Jan 2028
rows: Both 2027 releases were delivered on their baselined dates: Release 1 (product configuration engine) 26 Mar 2027 and Release 2 (straight-through disbursement) 17 Dec 2027. Cost performance recovered from 90% at Q1 to 91% at year end after the recovery plan agreed by the PSC on 23 Apr 2027.

Project Due Date 15 May 2028 · PSC: Florence Nightingale (PO), Grace Hopper (BM), Leonardo da Vinci (SP), PM, Marie Curie (UR), Albert Einstein (AO) · PCT: Nikola Tesla, Ada Lovelace, Gustave Eiffel (CPM, Levallois)

D-04 Release 1 — target 26/03/2027, actual 26/03/2027, achieved (partial acceptance, two product templates deferred) · D-05 Release 2 — target 17/12/2027, actual 17/12/2027, achieved · D-06 Parallel run — target 08/01/2028, planned
Total planned effort at completion 1.420 PD · 2027 planned 720 PD · actual 762 PD · progress (earned value) 698 PD · schedule 97% · budget 92%
1.4 Project Plan — WP4 Data migration & reconciliation
Total planned effort at completion 480 PD · 2027 planned 210 PD · actual 231 PD · progress 196 PD · schedule 93% · budget 85% — the worst-performing package
Planned 1.395 PD · actual 1.471 PD · progress 1.342 PD · schedule 1.342/1.395 = 96% · budget 1.342/1.471 = 91%

2026 actual 1.764 · 2027 actual 3.986 · 2028 forecast 3.481 · 2029 maintenance 970 · 2030 maintenance 970 · TCO 2026–2030 = 11.171 k€. Development is 6.971 k€ of that; claimed on the Information Systems budget line.

CR-007 Add SRF common-backstop screens to Release 2 — Scope — Postponed — 145 PD / €392.000 — Size L, Priority Medium — approval decided by the PSC on 26 Mar 2027. CR-005 audit-trail export for Internal Audit — Approved, 24 PD, delivered 30 Jun 2027.

R-03 ESM Treaty reform not ratified — Likelihood M, Impact H, Level High, owner Florence Nightingale, response Accept and keep the configuration engine instrument-agnostic. R-07 loss of Levallois key architect — Level High — materialised on 04 Oct 2027 and was moved to the Issue Log as I-12.

I-12 Levallois solution architect resigned — Resource — urgency High, impact High, size M — deputy architect activated under the retention clause, four-week knowledge transfer completed 12 Oct 2027, owner Gustave Eiffel.
Parallel run readiness review — due 05 Jan 2028 — Marie Curie (UR) with Grace Hopper (BM). Retraining of 40 loan administrators — due 30 Apr 2028 — Business Implementation Group.
Both releases delivered on their baselined dates; manual re-keying of payment instructions down from ~1.400 fields per quarter to 310 in Q4 2027 against a target of 0 (SC4).
